description: Seimas votes (the Lithuanian parliament; preview): find votes by a draft number ('XVP-1885'), the number of the law a draft amends ('XIV-1381'), an act on this site ('DK', 'darbo kodeksas') or Lithuanian words of the agenda item. Newest first: when, what was voted on, for/against/abstain, the result, the lrs.lt record. Says what the data lack (factions, consensus decisions and secret ballots have no individual votes).

query.description: A draft number, a law number, an act (with article numbers: 'DK 138'), or words (all must occur); empty: the newest votes

term.description: Seimas term (kadencija) id (10: 2024–2028, 9: 2020–2024); default the term of `from`/`to`, else the current one

name: search_votes
